title: Packages
subtitle: Prepaid hours and days you can use on bookings.

how.title: How packages work
how.p1: A package either covers a booking fully, or you pay the full price. It is never split.
how.p2: The balance is reserved when the booking is confirmed and used when you check in.
how.p3: If you cancel in time, the reserved balance returns to the package.
